note: New view drawn for this edition; the printed Google Earth image stays withheld. Highways from OSM; the King's Highway is shown only in the area of the printed view. The printed alternative routes ALT-1 to ALT-4 have no open source and are not shown. Amman is the end of the Desert Highway line (OSM node 1643504896). The static EPUB image (replacements/p302-x1173-open-view.png, scripts/jordan_maps.py) is a perspective relief view.
